steps.note: Observe current screen to find quick settings or Settings app
Read quick settings panel tiles
Expand quick settings fully to see WiFi and Bluetooth tiles
Use Settings app Network & internet to turn off WiFi
Close notification shade and see Settings app
Open Network & internet to reach Internet/WiFi toggle
Tap Internet entry to reach WiFi toggle
Verify WiFi switch unchecked, then go back to settings and open Connected devices/Bluetooth
Re-observe screen after device disconnect, then toggle WiFi switch
Go back to Network & internet then Settings home and open Connected devices
Read Network & internet page, then navigate up to Settings home
From Settings home open Connected devices to enable Bluetooth
Open Connected devices page and find Bluetooth switch
Open Connection preferences to reach Bluetooth toggle
Open Bluetooth settings page and toggle Bluetooth on
Verify Bluetooth switch is Checked and WiFi remains off
Re-read Bluetooth page to confirm switch Checked and WiFi off; then done
Back to Connected devices to confirm Bluetooth status text
View Connected devices page to confirm Bluetooth is on
Nothing left; task complete
